newsitem.title: UK: London Elec no comment on Entergy report.
newsitem.headline: London Elec no comment on Entergy report.

text.p: London Electricity Plc said on Tuesday it had no comment to make on a report in the Wall Street Journal Europe that it may be the target of a possible 1.2 billion stg bid from Entergy Corp of the U.S.
The WSJ quoted Entergy spokesman Patrick Sweeney as saying Entergy was interested in the UK market and "obviously if you're interested, one of the results could indeed be an acquisition."
Sweeney on Monday denied to Reuters a report in The Sunday Telegraph newspaper that it was considering a bid for Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc.
But he added, "The second part of that is, we simply don't comment on situations until they get to a point until it is prudent to do so."

The Journal report said confidential Entergy company documents showed it seeking 1.1 billion pounds for an acquisition. The documents used a code name "Atlantic' for the target company, whose financial profile it said met that of London Electricity on numerous points.
"There is nothing for us to say. It is speculation and obviously we can't comment on a rumour," a London Electricity spokeswoman said.
